div.div: مَنْصُوبَةٌ , as an epithet, applied to a شَبَكَة or حِبَالَة (A net or snare) set, or set up. And hence, as a subst., like دَابَّةٌ and عَجُوزٌ, (assumed tropical:) An artifice, a stratagem, a trick, a plot, a resource, or an expedient: or a stratagem in the game of chess. You say سَوَّى فُلَانٌ منصوبةً [Such a one framed a stratagem, or plot]. (Z.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
